commons.title: Santa Fe Indian Market Fashion show 2014.jpg
commons.description: Wile Wile Wile dress by Sho Sho Esquiro (Kaska Dena) at the 2014 Santa Fe Indian Market fashion show. Her 2013 gown is made with seal fur, beaver tail, carp skin, beads, silk, and rooster feathers
commons.editorial_reason: The caption and source category specifically identify the dress as Kaska Dena, and the image visibly shows culturally attributed traditional-inspired clothing and adornment.
